en: Drag an idle conversation onto another project to change its working directory while preserving history and drafts. The source project remains available; existing files stay in place.

Add linked project directories beside the permission control. Codex and Claude inherit the task’s current permissions for these directories; restricted tasks do not silently relay to unsupported providers.
Group Claude progress across tool calls and keep successful final answers separate, including compatible grouping of historical progress messages.
Move the compact Fast switch beside Send, refine the composer layout, make the Prism logo return to the home screen with drafts preserved, and remove the redundant top-bar view-settings button.
Build the background process host without a console window, hide child startup windows explicitly, and share simultaneous model-list queries to avoid duplicate CLI launches.
zh: 将未在执行的对话拖到另一个项目，即可更换工作目录并保留历史和草稿；原项目入口继续保留，已有文件留在原处。
在权限旁添加关联项目目录。Codex 和 Claude 对关联目录沿用任务现有权限；受限任务不会自动交给不支持关联目录的入口。
合并 Claude 跨工具调用的过程说明，将成功执行的最终答复单独显示，同时兼容整理历史进度消息。
将紧凑的 Fast 开关移到发送按钮旁，调整输入区排版；点击棱镜 Logo 返回主页并保留草稿，移除顶部重复的视图设置按钮。
后台进程宿主改为不创建控制台窗口，明确隐藏子进程启动窗口；同时请求模型列表时共用一次查询，避免重复启动 CLI。
